01 — About Identity

CSE student building at the intersection of cybersecurity and full-stack development.

Combining offensive security curiosity, cloud certifications, and hands-on project experience to deliver practical, secure software solutions.

I am a 3rd-year Computer Science Engineering student at National Engineering College, Kovilpatti, with a focused interest in cybersecurity, full-stack development, and cloud technologies. I hold ISC² CC certifications across all 5 domains and have achieved Elite grade in NPTEL Industrial IoT 4.0 — demonstrating both theoretical depth and academic discipline.

On the offensive security side, I actively participate in international and national CTF competitions including H7CTF, YUKTHI CTF 2.0, ISEA ISAP CTF, COCON/Evil Corp CTF, and CyberKavach. My project work spans a Java Spring Boot + Hibernate full-stack platform and a live MERN stack AI Food Delivery app under my current internship at WebStack Academy, Bangalore.
